title: SATELLITE PARIS
overview: Email design system and lifecycle campaigns for the Parisian fashion brand.
description:
For a Parisian house defined by craftsmanship, every digital touchpoint must feel like a piece of jewelry. I architected a complete visual ecosystem—from high-fidelity newsletters to strategic abandoned cart and post-purchase sequences.

The objective was to translate the boutique's elegance into a high-performing digital journey. By redesigning the brand’s newsletters, web banners, and on-site pop-ups, I established a cohesive visual language that prioritizes both brand equity and performance. This artistic overhaul directly resulted in a 12% increase in revenue, proving that sophisticated design is a powerful driver for luxury growth.
services: Email design, lifecycle campaigns, visual system
